current_contract.residual_test: OLS gamma/se from delta r_t = c + gamma r_{t-1} + error_t

all_null_diagnostic.design: five-market local clusters with I(1) logit levels; V6 cross-sectional mean factor; no stationary residual alpha; 200 deterministic clusters per cell

interpretation: When all residual signals are null, FDR equals the probability of any rejection. The current V6 standard-normal p-values are not valid unit-root p-values, so BH at q=0.10 does not provide 10% FDR control in this controlled diagnostic. Pairability can also arise under the null, so downstream opposite-residual/hedge-sign logic does not repair the inference defect.
required_next_experiment: keep broad local clusters and low paper-only discovery thresholds
calibrate residual mean-reversion under a unit-root null with dependence-aware inference before multiplicity control
compare incumbent standard-normal-plus-BH against robust unit-root/FDR alternatives on identical chronological local panels
report candidate survival, factor and hedge stability, maker executable edge, partial-fill and unwind economics, and realized OOS PnL at 1x/1.5x/2x costs
do not interpret more FDR-eligible candidates as alpha without common-sample executable utility
